jobs.title: Director, IT & Business Enablement
jobs.description:
### **Company Background**

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

As Director of IT & Business Enablement, you'll own the systems, tools, and technology experience that power every team at Censys. Your mandate: make our internal tools fast, reliable, and easy to use — and make sure we're getting maximum leverage out of AI across everything we run. You understand that availability and usability are often in tension, and you know how to balance both without slowing the business down.

You'll own the full lifecycle of our internal technology stack — from endpoint provisioning and SaaS tooling to the adoption, integration, and optimization of AI across our systems. You're the person every employee turns to for equipment and tooling needs, and the person finance turns to for software utilization and budget decisions. You're energized by automating the boring stuff and building systems that act as force multipliers for the company.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own, build, and scale the team and systems supporting Censys's IT infrastructure
* Own company technology needs end-to-end: new hire equipment, IT onboarding, and the tools that keep employees productive
* Hire, mentor, and develop members of the IT team to support evolving needs of our global workforce
* Own the complete endpoint lifecycle: provisioning, application deployment and endpoint patching, and asset retirement
* Manage and administer identity systems that enable access to corporate systems and infrastructure
* Enable secure AI adoption across the company: identify where AI can improve internal tools and workflows, lead integration of AI capabilities into our systems, and continuously optimize existing AI tooling for effectiveness and ROI
* Evaluate, select, and manage the internal tooling and software stack, ensuring the right tools are in place and being used effectively
* Own software and hardware budget planning and vendor management in partnership with finance
* Build and maintain documentation for IT processes, systems, and support workflows
* Develop and deliver internal training on tools and systems to drive adoption
* Other duties as assigned

**Skills/Experience you’ll have:**

* 10+ years of experience in IT management, systems administration, or technology operations, including 5+ years leading a team
* Proven experience owning endpoint lifecycle management (provisioning, deployment, retirement) at scale, ideally for a fully or hybrid-remote workforce
* Hands-on experience managing a modern SaaS tooling stack (identity/access management, MDM, collaboration tools, etc.) and making build-vs-buy / consolidate-vs-expand decisions
* Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into business workflows (not just using AI tools personally, but leading adoption across a team or company –e.g., rolling out AI-powered support tools, automating workflows with AI, evaluating AI vendor tooling)
* Experience managing software/hardware budgets and vendor relationships, with the ability to translate technical decisions into cost and ROI terms for finance and leadership
* Strong track record of building documentation, processes, and support systems from scratch
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills, and comfortable being the technical translator between engineering, finance, and non-technical employees

For high cost of living areas in the US (San Francisco / Seattle / NYC), the expected salary range for this position is $200,000 USD - $230,000 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity.
  
  
For all other locations in the US, the expected salary range for this position is $180,000 USD - $220,000 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity.

For candidates being considered outside of the US, location specific market data will be evaluated and discussed during the interview process.

Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. The listed range is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified. For roles that are available to be filled remotely, the pay range is localized according to employee work location by a factor of between 83% and 100% of range. Please discuss your specific work location with your recruiter for more information.

For US Employees: Censys offers a competitive benefits package to employees, including equity, health, dental & vision coverage, retirement with company contribution, parental leave, mental health & wellness benefits, flexible PTO, and a professional development stipend. Censys also offers sales incentive pay for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. Please see our careers page for more details. For employees located outside of the US, location-specific benefits are available and the information pertaining to those will be provided to you during the interview process.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to your recruiter. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

**Company:** Sardine  
**Location:** United States / Remote  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Position Overview

Sardine is seeking an experienced **Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** to lead the company’s global technology organization and define the next generation of its AI-powered risk and financial crime prevention platform.

The CTO will oversee engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data infrastructure, cybersecurity, and platform architecture. This executive will work closely with the CEO, Product, Risk, Security, and Revenue leadership teams to scale Sardine’s technology platform and maintain its competitive advantage in fraud prevention, AML compliance, payments, identity, and financial crime intelligence.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and execute Sardine’s global technology strategy and long-term technical roadmap.
* Lead Engineering, AI/ML, Data Engineering, Infrastructure, and technical architecture organizations.
* Scale a highly reliable, secure, and globally distributed technology platform.
* Drive the development of AI-powered fraud detection, AML, identity, and risk decisioning systems.
* Oversee machine learning infrastructure, data pipelines, real-time decisioning, and risk intelligence capabilities.
* Establish technical architecture and engineering standards to support rapid company growth.
* Partner closely with Product leadership to translate customer and market requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Strengthen platform security, reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and product development.
* Build and maintain a world-class engineering and technical leadership organization.
* Establish engineering KPIs, development processes, and operational metrics.
* Work closely with the CISO and Risk leadership on security, privacy, compliance, and platform resilience.
* Support enterprise customer engagements and strategic technical discussions with major financial institutions and fintech companies.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, infrastructure investments, and strategic technology partnerships.
* Provide technical strategy and risk assessments to the CEO, executive team, and Board of Directors.

Qualifications

* **15+ years of experience** in technology, software engineering, AI/ML, fintech, payments, financial technology, or related industries.
* Previous experience as a CTO, SVP Engineering, VP Engineering, or equivalent senior technology executive.
* Proven experience leading large-scale engineering and technology organizations.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, and real-time decisioning systems.
* Strong experience with AI, machine learning, data science, and production ML systems.
* Experience building highly secure and scalable financial technology or enterprise software platforms.
* Strong understanding of fraud prevention, AML, identity, payments, risk management, or financial crime technology.
* Proven experience scaling technology organizations during periods of rapid growth.
* Experience working with enterprise customers, financial institutions, fintech companies, or regulated businesses.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity, data privacy, regulatory requirements, and technology risk.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute long-term technology strategies.
* Exceptional executive communication, leadership, strategic thinking, and organizational development skills.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a **strategic, technically sophisticated technology executive with 15+ years of experience** building and scaling high-growth technology companies.

The candidate should have deep expertise across **AI, machine learning, distributed systems, data infrastructure, cybersecurity, and fintech**, with a proven track record of turning complex technology into scalable commercial products.

Experience in fraud prevention, financial crime, payments, identity verification, AML, or risk technology is highly desirable.

This leader should be equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, AI strategy with researchers, product strategy with executives, and business value with enterprise customers.

The ideal candidate is a strong organizational leader who can build world-class engineering teams, establish a culture of technical excellence, move quickly without compromising security or reliability, and help position Sardine as a leading **AI-powered financial crime prevention platform**.

Pay: From $350,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Clinical Training Program Manager
jobs.description:
Department:Behavioral Health

Reports To:Senior Director of Behavioral Health

Job Family:Behavioral Health

FLSA Status:Exempt

EEO Classification:Professionals

Supervisor:Yes

Leadership Level:Emerging Leader

Job Function:Essential Onsite

Provider Category:LIP

Overview

The Clinical Training Program Manager plays a crucial role in developing, implementing, and delivering training programs to enhance the skills and knowledge of staff working within the behavioral health division. This position is designed to ensure that staff are well-equipped to provide high-quality mental health and enabling services, with a specific focus on equitable and inclusive clinical practices. The Clinical Training Program Manager will serve as the conduit for academic programs seeking to place interns with the agency and provide clinical supervision to students. This position will provide direct supervision for early career clinicians and student interns, participating in recruitment, hiring, and evaluation. In addition, this position provides clinical care for up to two sessions per week.

Key Role Responsibilities

* Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing refinement of a behavioral health training program. Deliver trainings to providers within the behavioral health division that are grounded in evidence-based practices and align with divisional priorities and provider learning needs.
* Stay abreast of the latest research, trends, and best practices in behavioral health to ensure training content is current and relevant.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through feedback, assessments and measurable outcomes.
* Collaborate with other behavioral health professionals across the agency to create comprehensive and effective training materials. Customize training programs based on the unique requirements and goals of different organizations and funders.

* Maintain standards for provision of CEU in accordance with social work and professional counselor licensing boards for the state of MD. Track and issue CEU for training participants as appropriate.
* Provide direct supervision for early career clinicians and student interns and partner with the Senior Director of Behavioral Health in the recruitment, hiring, and evaluation of behavioral health staff and interns.
* Provide clinical services to a small caseload of clients for up to two sessions per week. Provide clinical coverage for staff as indicated.
* Completes documentation of services in a legible manner in accordance with established formats and required timeframes within the client’s electronic health record. Ensure that documentation accurately reflects billable services provided.

Key Agency Responsibilities

In addition to role responsibilities, each staff member of Health Care for the Homeless has the following responsibilities as a part of their employment:

* Models and reinforces the Health Care for the Homeless “core values” of dignity, authenticity, hope, justice, passion and balance
* Actively participates in performance improvement activities and actively participates in advocacy activities that support the mission of Health Care for the Homeless
* Performs other duties on an as-needed basis
* Protects our client’s personal health information by maintaining compliance with HIPAA and other relevant Health Care related IT security regulations

Knowledge, Experience, and Skills

Formal Education and Training

* Master’s degree in social work
* Active license in the state of Maryland (LCSW-C) with supervisory designation

Experience

* Three years of experience in the evaluation, diagnosis, and treatment of chronic mental illness and substance abuse
* Five years of experience supervising staff and/or interns, where there was emphasis on provision of training and ongoing education
* Experience working with homeless and/or low-income individuals and families
* Familiarity with adult learning principles and instructional design

Skills

* Able to work independently as a social worker on an interdisciplinary team
* Strong knowledge of various mental health disorders, treatments, and interventions
* Willingness to integrate relevant principles into practice such as Harm Reduction, Motivational Interviewing and Housing First
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Able to cope with interruptions and be a team player
* Flexible approach, working with several cross-disciplinary teams in a collaborative style
* Demonstrate comfort with change by approaching it optimistically and helps their supervisees to do the same. Proactively seeks to clarify unclear aspects of change in a productive, collaborative manner.
* Able to work with clients who have significant mental health challenges, manage crisis situations and assess for safety

jobs.title: Program Manager HCM (Workday)
jobs.description:
**Location and Remote Eligibility**

Fully remote candidates within the United States will be considered if they demonstrate substantial experience leading large-scale Workday implementations as a project manager, program manager, engagement manager, or delivery lead.

At Connect Centric, we are more than just consultants—we are partners committed to our clients' success. We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.

**Position Description**
========================

Connect Centric is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) initiatives for our client, with a primary focus on UKG and Workday. You will oversee multiple HCM workstreams, connecting implementation plans, platform enhancements, integrations, reporting, governance, and operational readiness across the program.  
  
This role requires direct experience supporting both UKG and Workday initiatives.

**What You Will Do**
====================

* Lead complex, cross-functional HCM programs and projects involving UKG, Workday, and related workforce management capabilities.
* Develop and manage integrated program plans, implementation roadmaps, schedules, milestones, budgets, dependencies, risks, and issues across HCM workstreams.
* Facilitate program governance and decision forums; prepare decision materials, document decisions, track actions, and provide status updates to senior leaders.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders, vendors, and workstream project managers to clarify scope, align priorities, resolve risks and issues, and maintain delivery momentum.
* Coordinate requirements, configuration decisions, business workflows, integrations, data validation, testing, and implementation readiness for UKG and Workday initiatives.
* Oversee cutover coordination, operational transition planning, and post-implementation stabilization across the HCM program.
* Prepare executive reports, dashboards, decision logs, and risk, assumption, issue, and dependency (RAID) logs; communicate delivery progress, tradeoffs, decisions, and adoption impacts.
* Support HCM process improvement, change management, stakeholder readiness, training coordination, and adoption planning.
* Develop and maintain program standards, templates, governance routines, tools, and delivery methodologies that improve consistency and readiness.
* Assess workforce processes, platform issues, data considerations, vendor capabilities, and platform roadmaps; recommend practical solutions to complex HCM challenges.
* Ensure work products meet business needs, quality expectations, compliance requirements, data integrity standards, configuration expectations, and delivery commitments.
* Balance competing HCM programs, platform enhancements, implementation activities, and stakeholder needs.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree and at least eight years of experience in program management, project management, business analysis, technology delivery, or a related field, including demonstrated experience supporting enterprise HCM platforms.
* Strong experience supporting both UKG and Workday initiatives, including implementation planning, enhancements, requirements definition, configuration coordination, business process alignment, and integration coordination.
* Experience coordinating HCM testing, data validation, security and access considerations, reporting, stakeholder readiness, training support, adoption, issue resolution, and post-implementation stabilization.
* Hands-on experience using UKG and Workday to support program delivery, platform reporting, issue tracking, stakeholder communications, governance, testing coordination, cutover planning, and executive decision support.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex HCM programs or projects involving HR, payroll, finance, operations, technology teams, vendors, and senior leaders.
* Working knowledge of core HR, payroll, time and attendance, absence management, benefits, talent, workforce scheduling, reporting, and employee self-service processes.
* Strong understanding of scope, schedule, budget, risk, issue, dependency, resource, change, benefits, and stakeholder management.
* Experience supporting Agile or other delivery methodologies in enterprise platform, ERP, HRIS, payroll, workforce management, or HCM environments.
* Experience preparing and presenting executive reports, dashboards, status updates, decision materials, risk summaries, and implementation readiness updates.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Agile, Scrum, Prosci, ITIL, Workday, UKG, HRIS, or a similar certification.

**Position Details**

* Position Type: Full-time W-2 employment. Independent contractor or 1099 arrangements are not available for this position.
* Location: Washington D.C. / Remote for Exceptional Candidates outside of commuting radius.
* This position is hybrid (2x per week)
* Pay Rate: $130K - $140K
